title: Freeze joined software-admission evidence
description:
Scope: final configured-constraint supplement inventory/provenance under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/ and machine-readable admission results conforming to /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md. Freeze the independently derived supplement revision and collect actual Python/Rust/C TX-path results for the same base corpus and source revisions. Verify exact case consumption, source-backed constraints and actual no-TX evidence. This is a software-enforcement completion gate, not an RF measurement, test-session approval or postmeasurement authorization decision.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Depend on concrete scenario and consumer leaves plus the result contract, never the .12 parent, RF qualification or ci.15. This gate supplies evidence to joined CI and subsequent separately authorized RF work without forming a completion cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Every expected applicable supplement case was exercised through each declared production path, with no omissions, duplicate/unknown shapes or zero-case success. Constraint violations prevented real TX submission, and accounting outcomes match the independent interval/frame oracles. Source clauses, configurations, commands, environments, review evidence and raw result artifacts are recorded and schema-valid. Base expected values were not regenerated; the supplement has its own frozen digest. Unknown/unqualified configurations remain disabled, and no RF/grant approval is claimed.
